rules: T0 deterministic evidence is always attempted first when applicable
availability failure falls back laterally within the same tier/provider budget before escalating quality tier
quality escalation requires failed tests, failed gates, invalid contract output, repeated bounded patch failure, or explicit task risk
model self-reported uncertainty alone is not escalation evidence
expand only the missing context before moving to a stronger model
never retry indefinitely; one serious attempt per model is the default unless evidence identifies a narrow repair
sensitive context skips all OpenCode free models and Command Code Muse Spark 1.2 Contributor
Muse Spark 1.2 Contributor cannot close T4/T5 security, crypto, billing, privacy or irreversible-data decisions
Big Pickle cannot close architecture, security, crypto, billing, privacy or irreversible-data decisions
T5 requires independent outputs from Google and Command Code when both providers are available
after budget or provider exhaustion, escalate to human rather than silently changing policy
evidence_examples: two bounded patches failing the same acceptance criterion
